```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Global utility for Quarto/OJS data transformation
transpose = (obj) => {
  if (!obj || Object.keys(obj).length === 0) return [];
  const keys = Object.keys(obj);
  if (keys.length === 0 || !obj[keys[0]]) return [];
  return obj[keys[0]].map((_, i) => {
    const r = {};
    keys.forEach(k => r[k] = obj[k][i]);
    return r;
  });
}
```

## Results Analysis

### Training Dynamics

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import duckdb
from pathlib import Path

# Aggregate all training stats for visualization
results_path = Path("../results/nlp_baseline")
all_stats = []

for p in results_path.glob("**/training_stats.parquet"):
    df = pd.read_parquet(p)
    all_stats.append(df)

if all_stats:
    df_stats = pd.concat(all_stats, ignore_index=True)
else:
    df_stats = pd.DataFrame()

ojs_define(training_data = df_stats)
```

```{ojs}
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(transpose(training_data), {
      x: "epoch",
      y: "val_loss",
      stroke: "full_run_name",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      tip: true
    }),
    Plot.text(transpose(training_data), Plot.selectLast({
      x: "epoch",
      y: "val_loss",
      text: "adapter_dim",
      dx: 5,
      textAnchor: "start"
    }))
  ]
})
```
:::

::: {.column width="40%"}
#### Performance Sweep

-   **Stability**: All configurations converge within 10 epochs.
-   **Scaling**: Larger adapter dimensions ($d=512$) show lower final validation loss.
-   **Efficiency**: Only 1% of parameters trained.
:::

### Model Evaluation (ROC)

```{python}
#| echo: false
# Aggregate ROC curves
all_roc = []
for p in results_path.glob("**/test_roc_curves.parquet"):
    df = pd.read_parquet(p)
    all_roc.append(df)

if all_roc:
    df_roc = pd.concat(all_roc, ignore_index=True)
else:
    df_roc = pd.DataFrame()

ojs_define(roc_data = df_roc)
```

::: {.column width="40%"}
#### ROC Analysis

-   **Top Class**: "Sports" achieves near-perfect AUC (\> 0.98).
-   **Ambiguity**: "World" and "Business" show slight overlap.
-   **Robustness**: High AUC maintained across all hyperparam settings.
